description:
Save a client in the company's registry, or update a saved one.

It records a recipient for later issuances; it issues nothing.
A document already saved is refused with the existing client's
id — call get_client or pass that id here to update it instead.
Confirm the data with the user when any of it was inferred.

address.description: Postal address: street, number, neighborhood, city, state (UF), zip_code and city_code (IBGE). An NF-e to this client needs all of them.

country_code.description: BACEN country code, 1 to 4 digits. Required, and not 1058, when state is EX. Its check digit is not verified: the official table has countries whose digit does not close.

state_registration.description: Recipient's IE (inscrição estadual), NF-e only. Send it for a recipient registered as an ICMS contributor; ISENTO for an exempt one; leave it out for a non-contributor.

client_id.description: Update this saved client instead of creating one. Only the fields sent change.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

foreign_id.description: Passport or other document of a buyer abroad, used instead of tax_id.

name.description: Legal name (razao social) or full name.

notes.description: Free text kept with the client.

phone.description: Contact phone with area code, e.g. 11987654321.

state_registration.description: State registration (IE), digits or ISENTO. Leave it out for a non-contributor.

tax_id.description: CPF or CNPJ. Required, except for a buyer abroad (address.state EX).

name: save_client

outputSchema.description: One client the company keeps between issuances.

id.description: Pass it as client_id to issue_invoice or save_client.

source.description: manual, issued (imported from issued invoices) or issuance (saved by an issuance).

tax_id.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters, unpunctuated). A CNPJ may carry letters in its first 12 positions since July 2026, so never treat it as a number.
